title: Social Media Broadcasting & OSINT Signal Collection Pipeline
description: Integration of automated social platform agents (Telegram, RSS, Webhooks) for content broadcasting and OSINT signal ingestion into territory passports.

components.description: Asynchronous multi-platform publisher that formats telemetry, alerts, and generated intelligence reports from Kancelyariya Facade into structured social posts (Telegram, Webhooks, Markdown feeds).
OSINT signal collector that parses incoming external feeds, sanitizes input, and links verified signals to integer primary key regions in data/regions.json and territory passports.
Integration tests ensuring end-to-end signal collection, verification against data/manifest.json schema, and dry-run broadcasting.

invariants: All broadcast content must strictly derive from validated portal state or territory passports without external hallucination.
Ingested OSINT signals must match valid region IDs from data/regions.json.
Broadcasting errors must trigger graceful resource-aware retry without breaking core P2P transport.
